cohort: A total of 170 high-risk women undergoing caesarean section were included in the study.
finding: Intrauterine misoprostol significantly reduced intraoperative and postoperative blood loss and haemoglobin change compared to per-rectal misoprostol, although shivering was more common with the intrauterine route.
mod_finding: Misoprostol effectively managed PPH during caesarean sections via both administration routes, but intrauterine misoprostol significantly reduced blood loss compared to the rectal route.
